notes.manas-2010:p0048:b002:l001: Каяшаяк visibly printed; interpreted contextually as каяша (answering back). Immediately following source region 48:2–4 is unresolved and may hide verse: this batch is not certified complete through that gap.
notes.manas-2010:p0048:b002:l013: Агача interpreted as noble/high-status woman; precise category remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0048:b002:l026: Комокойлуу denotes thickening where spear iron joins shaft, not a hollow throat. Corrected to thickened iron socket after Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/комок/ . Сыр follows the smooth-spear sense in that entry; painted is another possible contextual reading.
notes.manas-2010:p0048:b002:l040: Зыйкырчы visibly printed, interpreted as variant/defect of сыйкырчы (sorcerer); raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0049:b002:l002: Жырым interpreted as girth strap. Three/four straps and the associated omen are preserved without an invented ethnographic explanation.
notes.manas-2010:p0049:b002:l003: Заңгел retained as Zanggel; exact mountain identification unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0049:b002:l015: Кубары is uncertain; fierce is a provisional contextual epithet in the warning about renewed Kyrgyz strength.
notes.manas-2010:p0049:b002:l031: Бил мүчөлүү interpreted as elephant-built; see 45:28. Бадирек rendered brute provisionally.
notes.manas-2010:p0050:b002:l004: Назар сала албайт is interpreted as inability to cast an evil eye; inability even to look at him is also possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0050:b002:l015: Отогот interpreted as headgear plumes/ornament; exact form and ceremonial classification unresolved. Same at 50:46.
notes.manas-2010:p0050:b002:l035: Артынан interpreted temporally as aftermath/what follows, in Döngö’s fear of future revenge; literal behind is also possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0051:b002:l011: Эрен кабырга provisionally treated as the place Eren-Kabyrga in a sequence of exile destinations; reading as spear action against a warrior’s ribs is also grammatically possible. Requires specialist collation; no geographic claim certified.
notes.manas-2010:p0051:b002:l025: Энчисине басып төмөнкү is elliptical; draft interprets an allotted share handed to the Manchu/Sibe named in the next row. Exact syntax unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0051:b002:l048: Желпиниш retained as Jelpinish; destination identity unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0052:b002:l010: Башаа/башaаны rendered ruler, not a certified historical rank; the visible form may be defective.
notes.manas-2010:p0052:b002:l011: Ажайып interpreted as marvelous things built in Margalang; no palace or other specific structure invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0052:b002:l014: Айда сабап interpreted as monthly exaction accompanied by whipping; could instead describe driving and beating. Same wording repeats at 52:18.
notes.manas-2010:p0052:b002:l019: Кундуз rendered otter pelts after Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/kunduz/ ; draft corrected beaver to otter. Jamby ingot unit and both explicit numbers retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0052:b002:l034: Сан retained as san, epic multitude unit, not converted into a precise number; kalday likewise retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0052:b002:l037: Күчүн берип refers contextually to the hauling power of the six oxen and four mules; no additional beasts supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0052:b002:l042: Көк жашык is an emaciation/weakness idiom, corrected from a literal blue/watery-flesh reading. Kyrgyz phraseological/explanatory dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/?lfrom=kg&lto=ru&page=main&word=Көк .
notes.manas-2010:p0053:b002:l015: Мыйзам гүлү is autumn airborne spider gossamer, not a flower. Corrected after the exact formula in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/myyzam-6/ .
notes.manas-2010:p0053:b002:l024: The witness explicitly places Üch-Aral at the head of the Ile; epic topography preserved without modern geographic correction.
notes.manas-2010:p0053:b002:l042: Кыбыла rendered qibla (direction of prayer), without imposing a compass direction on the scene.
notes.manas-2010:p0054:b002:l031: Бөрсө retained as börsö: an epic pouch-bearing animal. The Kyrgyz explanatory dictionary identifies it as kangaroo, https://el-sozduk.kg/borso-4/ ; no claim that modern kangaroos inhabit Altay is made.
notes.manas-2010:p0054:b002:l036: Киши кийик rendered wild human creatures and төө кийик wild camels; fantastical bestiary left as narrated, not assigned modern species.
notes.manas-2010:p0055:b002:l009: Кысыр understood as barren/unbred mares in the horse-keeping context; the noun mare is supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0055:b002:l024: Кысыр тай is an awkward young/unbred equine expression, rendered young barren filly; exact husbandry referent remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0055:b002:l038: Күнөкөр is a variant of күнөөкөр (guilty person/sinner) in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/күнө/ ; culprits follows exile context, not a translator’s judgment.
notes.manas-2010:p0055:b002:l040: Contextually retranslated from the complete formula Ордолуу шайык көк жөкөр. Primary 1960 Semetey glossary PDF374 explicitly identifies it as an epithet of Kokand: great/holy/famous city and capital inhabited by many sheikhs. The complete formula, source image and adjacent Kyrgyz verses were individually reviewed; ordinary жөкөр dictionary footwear/retainer senses do not govern this geographic formula. Original raw text, IDs, coordinates and source lineation remain unchanged. Exiled Muslims contrast their distant homeland with Altai; the city epithet is elliptical here, without separately repeating Kokand. Exact glossary supports city, not footwear.
